description: Restricted SunSpec profile for the Voltix simulated site. Not universal model conformance; unsupported points serve the type sentinel or a documented fixed value.

points.name: PFWInjEna
comments: Set Power Factor (when injecting active power)

points.name: PFWAbsEna
comments: Set Power Factor (when absorbing active power)

points.name: WSetEna
comments: Set Active Power Level (may be negative for charging)

domain_conventions.site_power_kw: positive = exporting to grid (simulator-defined meter convention; the adapter normalises at its boundary)

control_write.description: One atomic FC16 request covering WSetEna..WSet (4 registers) sets enable, mode and target together.
control_write.readback: read WSetEna/WSetMod/WSet after write to confirm
control_write.watchdog: only an accepted complete write of this window refreshes the simulator's 10 s power-command deadline

disallowed: writes to read-only points -> Modbus exception 02
partial write of the WSet window (WSet without Ena/Mod) -> rejected, no watchdog refresh
points marked unsupported in this profile serve the type sentinel
